title: Technical Interview Preparation
intro: Technical interview prep (fresher level) is the meta-skill module — how to handle the interview itself. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with approaching coding problems and explaining your thought process (the two skills that matter most), then whiteboard coding tips. Mock interview approach and handling unknown questions follow at the practice tier, then common fresher mistakes. Post-interview follow-up and system-design intro questions close the module.
